rationale: The frozen source posts daily transactions and validates card/account lookup, credit limits and account expiry. It does not establish responsibility for clause 20's unused-card closure lifecycle. Absence of that lifecycle in this transaction batch is insufficient to substantiate D2_missing_rule at the proposed locus. The required inactivity history, cardholder notice, reply tracking, dues handling and CIC update interfaces are not exposed. All behavioral fixture checks are empty, so neither intended compliance nor preservation of existing behavior is demonstrated.
scope_judgment: CBTRN02C.cbl lines 370-378 contain only the transaction-validation dispatcher and an extension comment. The batch runs this dispatcher for incoming daily transactions, which does not establish a way to discover cards with no use for more than one year. The allowed scope supplies no demonstrated persistent inactivity/notice/reply state, closure orchestration or CIC reporting interface. Account open, expiry and reissue dates and current transaction timestamps cannot be assumed to represent last card use or notice dates. The local scope is unsupported for the composite regulatory behavior.
intended_fixture_judgment: The intended-regulatory-behavior array is empty and therefore unavailable, not a pass. There are no concrete indexed-file initial states, execution inputs or expected closure/notice/CIC outputs. Coverage is absent for exactly one year versus more than one year, calendar-year and leap-day semantics, notice delivery, replies before or at the 30-day boundary, no reply after the window, outstanding dues and settlement, or CIC reporting within and beyond 30 days. No fixture shows processing of an inactive card without an incoming transaction.
regression_fixture_judgment: Both unaffected-outside-locus and class-specific-regression arrays are empty. The PROCEDURE DIVISION literal assertion provides structural evidence only. It cannot demonstrate preservation of valid posting, invalid card/account rejection, credit-limit and expiry boundaries, rejection details, account/category balance updates, transaction writes or file-error behavior.
capability_judgment: The packet records GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 and batch_executable/copybook_fanout support, but case_checks_executed is false. Backend availability does not demonstrate executable fixtures, usable indexed-file dependencies or observable external closure/CIC effects. Proof is explicitly limited to finite case fixtures; the listed static limitations include absent complete semantic equivalence and REDEFINES alias proof. No behavioral pass or full compliance conclusion is supported.
duplicate_source_judgment: The declared preselection before detector results, retained dependent source-bundle groups, disclosure of case and distinct-bundle counts, and avoidance of independent-case interval claims form a defensible conditional dependence policy. This single packet cannot independently verify the repeated pairs or preselection history. Dependence must remain disclosed, and the all-reviewers-approve condition cannot justify retention when this case is excluded.
unresolved_issues: The packet does not establish that this transaction-posting host owns the clause 20 lifecycle or that the proposed local omission is an actionable D2_missing_rule.
No source-grounded mapping exists for last card use, notice and reply state, closure subject to dues, or CIC reporting.
Concrete intended and regression execution fixtures and their boundary expectations are unavailable.
No case execution results establish behavior under the declared backend.
Repeated-source preselection and pair-specific justification remain declarations that cannot be verified within this single-case review.
